blocks.text: The Philippines is set to make softball history. This December, the Philippines will host the U18 Men’s Softball Asia Cup for the first time, welcoming Asia’s top young softball athletes to Clark, Pampanga for a landmark championship led by the Amateur Softball Association of the Philippines (ASAPHIL). For the first time, the continent’s rising softball stars will compete on Philippine soil, signaling a major milestone for the sport and reinforcing the country’s growing presence within the Asian softball community. The tournament reflects years of efforts by ASAPHIL, supported by Cebuana Lhuillier Sports, to strengthen grassroots programs, develop athletes, and create more […]...
